units.source_text: 发长彦很开心，带着这条白狗回到了家里。

en.t: Nagahiko was very happy, and he took the white dog home with him.

units.source_text: 第二天，他在山里吹奏笛子的时候，突然，不知道从哪里来了一个身材高大的独臂男子，

en.t: The next day, while he was playing his flute in the mountains, a tall one-armed man suddenly appeared from nowhere,

units.source_text: 男子脖子上带着黑玉，看着他说：

en.t: The man wore a black jewel around his neck, looked at him, and said:

units.source_text: “昨天我听说我哥哥独脚大仙送给你一条狗，

en.t: Yesterday I heard that my elder brother, the One-Legged Great Immortal, gave you a dog,

units.source_text: 那么今天我也来向你表达我的谢意。

en.t: so today I have come as well to express my gratitude to you.

units.source_text: 你有什么想要的东西，都可以直接跟我说。

en.t: If there is anything you want, you may tell me directly.

units.source_text: 我是葛城山里的独臂大仙。”

en.t: I am the One-Armed Great Immortal of Mount Katsuragi.
